To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
nitric oxide (a free radical molecule) plays a role in thermoregulation by brown adipose tissue.
nitric oxide (an endothelium-derived relaxing factor) is involved in thermogenic function of interscapular brown fat tissue in rats.
NO activity is involved in enhancement by cold acclimation or immobilization stress in the thermogenic functions in BAT in rats.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of cold adaptation and immobilization stress on NO activity in interscapulat brown adipose tissue of rats.
the effect of cold acclimatation and immobilization stress on NO activity in BAT.
the effects of NO on the thermogenesis of BAT.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NO is involved, in part, in thermogenesis of BAT, and the NO activity is enhanced in the basal condition of BAT of cold acclimated and immobilization adapted rats.
NO activity in BAT is increased by cold acclimation, immobilization stress, and noradrenaline, and that this increase is related to the enhancement of thermogenic function.
NO is involved, in some way, in the enhancement of thermogenesis in BAT in rats.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cold acclimated and immobilized rats have higher NO activity in the BAT and that this activity may be involved in the thermogenic functions.
NO is involved not only in BAT thermogenesis but also in the regulation of BAT thermogenesis.
the NO activity of BAT is enhanced in cold-acclimated rats and in the immobilized rats.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NO activity in BAT is enhanced in the basal condition by cold acclimation or immobilization stress.
NO activity in BAT was enhanced in cold acclimation or immobilization stress-adapted rats in the basal state.
the NO activity in brown adipose tissue is increased by cold acclimation or immobilization stress, and that the enhanced NO activity is involved in the thermogenic function of BAT.
